# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Wave 8 Worker 3 Slot 98: Americas Three Indigenous Empires & Nova Elysia Bidirectional Synergy (oe_amr_, 0 vanilla/GUI/DLC overrides). Generated by gen_v130_americas.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Grand Cap Slot 98 entry: scheduler host scope, months 2/5/8/11 (staggered with Slot 97 1/4/7/10).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via global_var:oe_amr_ran_m.
oe_amr_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_pulse_count add = 1 }

	# Autonomous AI world-milestone safety nets when Rule #17 is not Players Only.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1520
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_triple_alliance_reformed }
				any_country = {
					oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
					owns = location:tenochtitlan
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_triple_alliance_reformed value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1525
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_completed }
				any_country = {
					oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
					owns = location:qusqu
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_completed value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1500
				oe_amr_elysia_present = yes
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact }
				NOT = {
					any_country = {
						oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
						is_ai = no
					}
				}
				any_country = {
					oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
					num_locations > 0
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_country = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes oe_eln_is_limes_path = yes } }
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_pact value = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_pact value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: protagonist quarterly check (months 2/5/8/11).
oe_amr_country_tick = {
	# Rule #17 Full AI Rival bonus (mode = replace, 10-year cadence).
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_rival_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	# Zero-DLC D015/D017 passive sacred pyramid pilgrimage check for Mesoamerica.
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			oe_amr_holds_sacred_pyramids = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_pyramid_syn_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_pyramid_syn_cd years = 15 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_amr_holds_both_sacred_pyramids = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_dual_pyramids_synergy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_sacred_pyramid_pilgrimage_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	oe_amr_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one story event per quarter when eligible.
oe_amr_story_tick = {
	# --- Mesoamerica arc (events 1-6) ---
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev1_done }
			current_year >= 1345
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1422
			OR = {
				tag = TNC
				tag = TTZ
				tag = TCP
				tag = AZT
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev3_done }
			current_year >= 1360
			oe_amr_holds_sacred_pyramids = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev4_done }
			current_year >= 1455
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev5_done }
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1495
				country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_mesoamerica_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev6_done }
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1530
				has_advance = oe_amr_adv_obsidian_to_steel
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.6
	}
	# --- Andes arc (events 7-9, 11-12; event 10 fired by road on_built) ---
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev7_done }
			current_year >= 1380
			OR = {
				tag = CSU
				tag = INC
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev8_done }
			current_year >= 1438
			OR = {
				tag = CSU
				tag = INC
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev9_done }
			current_year >= 1465
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev9_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev11_done }
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1498
				country_has_disease = disease:great_pestilence
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev11_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_andes_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev12_done }
			current_year >= 1545
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev12_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.12
	}
	# --- North America & v10.5 Nova Elysia bidirectional arc (events 13-15, 18) ---
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev13_done }
			current_year >= 1375
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev13_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev14_done }
			current_year >= 1430
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev14_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev15_done }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_ev15_dispatched }
			oe_amr_elysia_present = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled_year
			current_year > global_var:oe_ely_settled_year
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev15_dispatched value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev15_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev18_done }
			NOT = { oe_amr_elysia_present = yes }
			OR = {
				oe_amr_old_world_in_north_america = yes
				current_year >= 1515
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_amr_ev18_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.18
	}
}

# Dev Panel Helpers for Page 89 (oe_dev.89, v130_amr_*, cmds 2175-2183)

oe_amr_dev_unlock_advances = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_triple_alliance_tribute } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_triple_alliance_tribute }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_obsidian_to_steel } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_obsidian_to_steel }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_tawantinsuyu_quarantine_mita } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_tawantinsuyu_quarantine_mita }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_kayanerenkowa_federation } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_kayanerenkowa_federation }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_woodlands_flintlock_diplomacy } } research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_woodlands_flintlock_diplomacy }
}

oe_amr_dev_force_tick = {
	oe_amr_monthly = yes
	oe_amr_country_tick = yes
}

oe_amr_dev_triple_alliance = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_triple_alliance_pact_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { oe_amr_holds_both_sacred_pyramids = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_dual_pyramids_synergy_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_amr_holds_sacred_pyramids = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_sacred_pyramid_pilgrimage_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.2
}

oe_amr_dev_nahuatl_focuses = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:nahuatl
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_completed_religious_focus = oe_amr_rf_chinampa_agronomy } }
			add_religious_focus = religious_focus:oe_amr_rf_chinampa_agronomy
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_completed_religious_focus = oe_amr_rf_calmecac_codices } }
			add_religious_focus = religious_focus:oe_amr_rf_calmecac_codices
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_completed_religious_focus = oe_amr_rf_pochteca_intelligence } }
			add_religious_focus = religious_focus:oe_amr_rf_pochteca_intelligence
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_completed_religious_focus = oe_amr_rf_anti_pestilence_herbalism } }
			add_religious_focus = religious_focus:oe_amr_rf_anti_pestilence_herbalism
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.90
}

oe_amr_dev_qhapaq_nan = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_amr_adv_qhapaq_nan_engineering
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:qusqu }
		location:qusqu = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_amr_quipu_tambo_archive } }
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:oe_amr_quipu_tambo_archive
					cost_multiplier = 0
					cost_multiplier_reason = oe_amr_pachacuti_free_build_reason
					instant = yes
				}
			}
			every_neighbor_location = {
				limit = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner = { this = root }
					NOT = { has_road_of_type_to = { target = location:qusqu type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road } }
				}
				add_road_to = { target = location:qusqu type = oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road }
			}
		}
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_pachacuti_tawantinsuyu_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.8
}

oe_amr_dev_great_law = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_kayanerenkowa_league_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.13
}

oe_amr_dev_sim_elysia = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_year value = current_year }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact }
		remove_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_ev15_dispatched }
		remove_global_variable = oe_amr_ev15_dispatched
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_amr_ev15_done }
		remove_variable = oe_amr_ev15_done
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified }
		remove_variable = oe_amr_elysia_notified
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.15
}

oe_amr_dev_anti_pestilence = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_triple_alliance_reformed value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_completed value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_mesoamerican_herbal_shield_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_amr_andean_tambo_quarantine_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.5
}

oe_amr_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_amr.90
}
